tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ mdor byas kyi rjes su 'brangs pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen rdo rje 'dzin zhabs la/ /gus pa'i yid kyi btud byas nas/ /de nyid bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang*/ /yan lag drug ldan rim pa bshad/ /de la 'dir ngag 'don tsam brjod par bya ste /de yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang ste/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas 'bru gsum gyis myang ngo*/ / oṃ swa bhā wa shungnghaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shungngho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa hūṃ du gyur/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ mi bskyod par gyur pa thugs kar drangs/ badzra dhṛka thugs ka nas phyir phyung phyogs bcur spros sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ slar 'dus ye shes pa dang 'dres/ rang la thim pas bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje nag po rtsa ba'i zhal rab tu khros pa/ nag dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo padma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' la padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan re re/ rang gi snying ga nas hūṃ yig bcu spros/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du 'khod/

hūṃ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs dang gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus te thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed/ lhor shes rab mthar byed/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams 'khod par gyur/ 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'ongs te mdun du 'dug nas/ bdag gis ci bgyi zhes bka' nod pa la/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ/ gṛhna gṛhna hūṃ/ gṛhna pā ya gṛhna pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bidya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas/ gnod mdzes de nyid gnod mdzes bcur gyur te/ g.yas dang po lcags kyu thogs pa rnams kyis/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams/ phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par gyur pa rnams zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus btab/ lhag ma mtshon cha sna tshogs pas sdigs te bkug nas phyi rol tu hūṃ las byung ba'i 'brub khung zab mo rnams su bcug par gyur/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa bcu spros te/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor zug oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣtaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badzra ki la badzra ngha ro ā dzña pa ya ti sarba bigha nan/ kā ya wāka tsitta badzra/ kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas/ de nyid rdo rje tho ba thogs par gyur te/ phur bu'i spyi bo nas brdungs/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug lus ngag yid gsum gyi g.yo ba chad de 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ gnod mdzes rnams 'og gi gnod mdzes la thim/

khro bo dang phur bu rnams las rdo rje'i me lce phyogs bcur sprod pas/ bgegs kyi lhag ma thams cad tshig cing bros/ me lce slar 'dus nas/ me'i ra gur du gyur/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥrdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ 'og tu hūṃ gi 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ steng du hūṃ las rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan mang du bzla/ de dag ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ / dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ / gang yang mi dmigs te stong pa la cung zad mnyam par gzhag ye shes kyis bskyed pa'o/ / stong pa'i ngang las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po zur gsum pa gdeng ka gyen du phyogs pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma'i lte bar/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i stong du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi po re re zhing*/ steng 'og gi logs gnyis su/ hūṃ gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje rang mdog dang mtshungs pa gnyis gnyis kyis mtshan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ de dang dus mnyam du rwa gur me lce'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung pa'i 'khor lo sngon bzhin du grub par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du bhruṃ las thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang rin po che sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun du khyab pa/

gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du/ dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dmar pos bskor ba'i steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i dra ba dra phyed/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i shar bu/ steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba la/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la/ bzhugs stangs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gzugs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig gi rtse mor/ padma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi mtshams dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i/ rin po che dmar po la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po dang dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi 'phreng ba thogs pa rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa ste/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub du padma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje rin po che'i tog gi spras pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/

mchod pa'i sprin thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i khang bzang dam pa/ nang gi steng 'og gi gzhi rnams/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i nang le tshe dgur gyur pa/ lha'i gnas thams cad du sna tshogs padma'i gdan re re/ gtso bo'i gnas dang*/ khro bo bcu'i gnas su nyi ma/ gzhan shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma kī la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la chu skyes dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan rnams su gyur/ de nas lhag mos kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang sngon po/ sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ padma/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rang dang mtshungs pa'i yum reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud pa thugs dkar mi bskyod pa/ le tshe brgyad la shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa rnams mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma kī/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma rnams rim pa bzhin du/ rtag pa/ mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje chos/ gdon mi za ba rnams kyi cod pan can/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma rnams kyang rim pa bzhin/ rtag pa la sogs pa'i cod pan can no/ / rim pa gsum pa'i lha rnams la shar gyi g.yas su byams pa/ g.yon du sa'i snying po gnyis/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi cod pan can/ lho'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje dang*/ g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po gnyis/ dkon mchog dpal gyi cod pan can/ nub kyi g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/

g.yon du 'jam dpal gnyis/ tshe dpag med kyi cod pan can/ byang gi g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po gnyis/ don yod grub pa'i cod pan can/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed rnam snang gi lho sgor gzhan gyi mi thub pa rin 'byung gi nub sgor rta mgrin 'od dpag med kyi/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed don grub kyi/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba rtag pa'i/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal rin chen tog gi nub byang du dbyug sngon can 'od dpag med kyi/ byang shar du stobs po che don yod rgyal po'i steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ 'og tu gnod mdzes gnyis/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i cod pan can rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad bkug nas/ dky-il 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas thogs pa med par zhugs pa la/ rjes chags las byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur bas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob nas/ rdo rje sems dpar gyur te/ rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ / de yan chad ni rnal 'byor gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas lhag mos de/ rang lus la bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad rang lus la zhugs/ spyi bor rnam snang dang sgrol ma/ mgrin par 'od dpag med dang gos dkar mo/ snying gar mi bskyod pa dang mā ma kī dang 'jam dpal/ lte bar rin 'byung dang spyan ma/ 'doms par du don grub/ mig tu sa snying dang gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar phyag rdor dang sgra rdo rje ma/ snar nam snying dang dri rdo rje ma/ lce la spyan ras gzigs dang ro rdo rje ma/ gsang sgor sgrib sel dang reg rdo rje ma/ tshigs rnams la kun bzang*/ spyi gtsug tu byams pa/

phyag g.yas la ya mān ta ka g.yon la pradzñān ta ka zhal la rta mgrin/ gsang bar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ dpung ba g.yas par mig g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rnams 'khod par gyur/ lhag mos don dam du bsdu ba ni/ rnam snang spyan ma gzugs dang byams pa dang*/ /sa snying gshin dgra mi g.yo 'od gsal thim/ / rin 'byung bdag ma sgra dang phyag rdor dang*/ /gzhan gyis mi thub 'dod rgyal 'od gsal thim/ /dpag med gos dkar dri dang nam mkha'i snying*/ /rta mgrin dbyug sngon 'od gsal ngang du thim/ /don grub sgrol ma ro dang 'jig rten mgon/ /sgrib sel kun bzang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ /stobs po che rnams 'od gsal dbyings su thim/ /gtsug tor gnod mdzes reg bya 'jam dbyangs la/ /'jam dpal mi bskyod pa la thim pa dang*/ /mi bskyod pa ni gzhi lus rdor sems la/ /de yang 'od gsal ngang du zhugs par gyur/ / de nas thams cad stong pa bde ba chen po rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag par mos/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de ni byang chub rnam pa lnga las de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa'o/ / stong pa'i ngang las dbus kyi gdan gyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ hūṃ nag po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥdamar po las 'dam skyes 'char ka'i mdog can 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ hūṃ āḥl thim/ āḥ.oṃ la thim/ oṃ padma la thim/ padma dang nyi ma zla ba la thim/ snod bcud thams cad kyang de la rab tu zhugs te/ sems tsam zla bar snang ba'o/ /oṃ dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zla ba las byang chub pa'o/ / lhag mos lus la bsdu ba nas/

de'i bar ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ / zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ brtsegs pa'o/ /sa bon las byang chub pa'o/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te thim pa las/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ dkar dmar mthing kas mtshan pa/ badzra ātma ko3haṃ/ phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o/ /de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes chags kyis byang chub sems su zhu ba las byung ba'i rgyal ba mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad byin gyis brlabs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob par gyur/ de dag ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ / tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang gi nang du gcig tu 'dres nas/ bdag nyid dang gnyis su med par gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sprul pa'i sku sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum nas/ rin po ches brgyan par gyur/

de nas lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyis yang dag brten/ / zur bzhi po ni mdun rgyab dang*/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so/ /steng 'og sgo yi dbye ba yis/ /sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin/ lte gsang snying ga gdong ste bzhi/ /sna yi rtse mo'i dbyibs kyis ni/ /rta babs bzhir ni brjod par bya/ /dra ba rgyu mar yang dag bshad/ /rgyus par gyur pa dra ba phyed/ /cha ni zla ba phyed pa dang*/ /bum pa lto bar yang dag bshad/ /rje ngar brla dpung lag ngar ni/ /ka pa brgyad du rnam par bshad/ /mig gi rnam shes me long sogs/ sgra yi rnam shes ba dan dang*/ sna yi rnam shes me tog 'phreng*/ /rin chen pha gu lce rnam shes/ /lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan dang*/ /yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags so/ /mig ni 'khor lo'i mtshan ma dang*/ /rna ba kun nas rdo rje rnams/ /sna ni ba dan du ni bshad/ / lce ni dril bu ru ni gsungs/ /rnga yab la sogs rnam dag pa/ /lus kyi tshogs shes bya bar bshad/ /yid kyi dbus kyi padmar gsungs/ /rnam rtog rlung ni yang dag bstan/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /re kha lngar ni yang dag brjod/ /phung po lnga ni yang dag lnga/ /rnam dag kha dog lnga ni byed/ /de dag gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ /spy-i bor gzugs phung oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'du shes āḥlas 'od dpag med/ snying gar rnam shes hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar tshor ba swā las rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'dom par du 'du byed hā las don yod grub pa/ slar yang lte bar sa khams laṃ las spyan ma/ snying khar chu khams maṃ las mā ma kī/ mgrin par me khams paṃ la gos dkar mo/ spy-i bor rlung khams tāṃ las sgrol ma rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ mig gi dbang po las sa'i snying po/ rna ba'i dbang po oṃ las phyag na rdo rje/ sna'i dbang po oṃ las nam mkha' snying po/

lce'i dbang po oṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug snying gar yid dbang hūṃ las 'jam dpal/ gsang sgor lus dbang oṃ las sgrib sel/ lus kyi tshigs mtshams rnams saṃ las kun tu bzang po/ spy-i gtsug tu rtsa rgyus maiṃ las byams pa/ sa'i snying po sogs drug la shes rab mas 'khyud pa ni/ mig gi sgor yul gzugs dzaḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna ba'i sgor yul sgra hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma/ sna'i sgor yul dri baṃ las dri rdo rje ma/ lce rtser yul ro hoḥlas ro rdo rje ma/ rtags kyi sgor yul reg bya khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma/ lag pa g.yas par hūṃ las gshin rje gshed/ g.yon par hūṃ las/ gzhan gyi mi thub pa/ khar hūṃ las rta mgrin/ gsang bar hūṃ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ dpung pa g.yas par hūṃ las mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par hūṃ las 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par hūṃ las dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par hūṃ las stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ las 'khor los sgyur ba/ rkang mthil du hūṃ las gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams bzhugs par gyur/ de dag ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ / de nas rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ las zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po 'od lnga 'phro ba/ de las spyan ma nam mkha' gang ba spros/ sku rdo rje rnam snang gi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ de'i gtso bo spyan ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje sku yis mdzad du gsol/ /sku rdo rje yab yum 'khor bcas bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yis rab tu rgyas/

/ sangs rgyas sku yi rang bzhin gyis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ 'dis 'og ma gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre bar bya ste/ lce'i dbus su āḥlas padma'i steng du ā dmar po 'od lnga 'phro ba/ de las gos dkar mo/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs/ gos dkar mo dang sbyor ba'i/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje= /deng bdag= /rdo rje gsung gis= /phyogs= /rdo rje= /deng bdag= /rdo rje gsung gis= /gsung rdo rje yab yum/ lce'i dbus su thim/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /gsung de nges tshig phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra ste/ /chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ snying gar hūṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ sngon po 'od lnga 'phro ba/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa mā ma kī dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje= /deng bdag = /rdo rje thugs kyis= / phyogs = /rdo rje= /deng bdag= /rdo rje thugs kyis= /thugs rdo rje yab yum/ snying gar thim/ gsang ba'i dbang po blo ldan pa/ /kun tu bzang po thugs gang yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bur ni/ /bdag gi sems kyang de 'drar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de ltar bdag nyid rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje dbyer mi phyed pa khyab bdag chen po'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta ātma ko3haṃ/ rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs padma dang zla ba la/ ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang ba'i yum la 'khyud pa/ de gnyis kha sbyor gyi sbyor bas dam tshig sems dpa'i lus rgyas par byed par gyur/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ nag po/

mar me chen po lta bu/ mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms pa'i 'od snang gi phung po rtag tu 'char ba'o/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' ral pa'i cod pan la/ rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po/ rang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa'i sbyor bas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zla ba zhun ma lta bu babs te bdag la thim pas tshim zhing bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur/ de dag ni rnal 'byor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas rig ma 'du bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas/ rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i ye shes kyi rig ma phyung*/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ dang rdo rje las rig ma de nyid reg bya rdo rje ma/ kha dog dang mtshon cha gtso bo dang mtshungs pa las/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ nu 'bur lhag par rgyas pa bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ rig pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par āḥlas 'od dpag med nas/ spyi bor tāṃ las sgrol ma rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mdun du bzhugs par gyur gyi bar gong bzhin las/ phung khams kyi ming dor/ de bzhin du mig gi sgor dzaḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma nas/ reg bya rdo rje ma 'i bar la'ang yul lnga'i ming dor/ de lnga char rang rang gi thabs la 'khyud pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas par hūṃ las ro langs ma/ g.yon par hūṃ las gzhan gyi mi thub ma/ khar hūṃ las khro gnyer can ma/ bha gar hūṃ las ral gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas par hūṃ las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum rdo rje ma/ g.yon par hūṃ las sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas par hūṃ las sna tshogs padma ma/ g.yon par hūṃ las sna tshogs las ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ las nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ rkang mthil du hūṃ las sa 'dzin lha mo rnams so/ khro mo 'di rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/

rang rang gi khro bo dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ / yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ nor bu la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa yum gyi gsang gnas āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur/ 'khyud pa la sogs pa rjes chags kyi spyod pa brtsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur/ rdo rje dang padma'i nang 'od zer sna lngas gang*/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ snyoms par zhugs/ phaṭa rang don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ sku'i cha thams cad nas zla ba byang chub kyi sems zhu zhing 'phel pas/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad bde bas tshim/ byang chub kyi sems shes rab ma'i chu skyes kyi dbus su sbrang rtsi ltar babs pas/ bde gshegs 'khor bcas thams cad mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ lus dkyil gyi lha rnams dang lhan cig thig ler zhu te/ rdo rje'i lam nas padmar babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig bhruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha so gnyis su gyur nas so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod/ skabs 'dir lha re re bzhin bskyed pa la/ sngags dang phyag mtshan sku gzugs bskyed/ /phyi rol spro zhing 'phrin las mdzad/ /gcig bsdus ye shes pa dang bsre/ /gnas su bkod de don tshan bdun// zhes pa ltar yin pas/ dbus kyi thig le oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ du gyur/ de las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de las lha bcur bzhengs pa ni/ mi bskyod nag po nag dkar dmar/ /dang po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /'khor lo pad ma g.yas pas te/ /dril bu nor bu g.yon na'o/

/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ /rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badzra dhṛka thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyad par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs te/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la/ gdod nas grub pa'i mi bskyod pa ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du thim/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur/ rang gi snying ga nas zhugs te thim pas/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang zhi ba de/ slar zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po ind+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ rtsa zhal mthing ka khro ba dang 'dod chags chen po 'dres pa'i nyams can/ mche ba'i myu gu rnon po gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal gsum kar yang rab tu mdzes pa'i smin tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i sor gdub kyis spras pa'i phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa dang*/ dril bu 'dzin pas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang mtshungs pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ gsum pa na padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ g.yon gnyis pa na rin po che ljang khu rtse mo dgu pa/ gsum pa na ral gri sngo sangs 'od zer 'bar pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po che'i thor tshugs dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan mgul rgyan/ do shal/ dpung rgyan/ gdu bu/ so mo do/ ska rags te rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/

snyan gong du utpala'i gdengs ka dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol zhing srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ le tshe brgyad la shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ dang 'khor lor gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar/ dang po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ rdo rje pad dkar g.yas pas ste rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ thugs kar drangs/ dzi na dz-ika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ nam mkha'i khams= chos kyi 'khor lor= khyad par du sems can thams cad kyi gti mug sbyangs te/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang*/ sprul pa rnams/ gdod nas grub pa'i/ rang gi rigs bdag nas/ dbang bskur/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar gyi re mig tu pad zla'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la sbyar te/ lho'i/ oṃ āḥswā hūṃ dang rin po cher/ rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar/ /dang po nor bu dril bu 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas pas te/ /pad ser ral gri g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ /ratna dhṛka nga rgyal dang ser sna sbyangs te rin 'byung gi gdod nas grub pa'i rin 'byung*/ lho'i re mig tu/ padma dang rin po che'i gdan la 'khod/ nub kyi oṃ āḥ.āḥhūṃ dang pad mar/ 'od dpag med dmar dmar nag dkar/ g.yon gyi dang po pad rtsa dang*/ dril bu lhan cig dkur brten 'dzin/ g.yas pas padma dmar po ni/ 'dab brgyad thugs kar kha 'byed pa'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas pa te/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can// a ro lika 'dod chags sbyangs te/ gdod nas grub pa'i 'od dpag med/ nub kyi re mig tu padma brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ byang gi oṃ āḥhā hūṃ dang ral grir/ don grub ljang khu ljang nag dkar/

/dang po ral gri dril bu 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ /padma ljang khu nor bu g.yon/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ /pradzñā dhṛka brdzun dang phrag dog sbyangs te don grub kyi/ gdod nas grub pa'i don grub/ byang gi re mig tu/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di man chad la chos kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du zhes pa'i tshig rnams dor bar bya'o/ / de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi yang*/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ shar lho'i oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ dang*/ utpal dkar po/ spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar/ /dang po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ /rdo rje utpal dkar po g.yas/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ / rnam snang mdzad kyi cod pan can/ /mo ha ra tī/ sems can gyi khams na gdon dang nad kyis gdungs pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad/ gdod nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas spyan ma/ shar lho'i re mig tu zla ba'i gdan la/ lho nub kyi oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ dang utpal sngo dmar du/ mā ma kī sngo sngo dkar dmar/ dang po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// 'khor lo utpal sngo dmar g.yas/ /dril bu nor bu g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rgyal po'i cod pan can/ /dwe ṣa ra tī/ sems can gyi khams na bgegs kyis gzir ba rnams las bsrungs te rgyas par mdzad/ grub pa'i mā ma kī/ lho nub kyi re mig tu rdo rje'i gdan/ nub byang gi oṃ āḥpaṃ hūṃ dang*/ utpal dmar po/ gos dkar mo dmar dmar nag dkar/ utpal rtsa ba g.yon dang pos/ / dril bu lhan cig dkur brten zhing*/ /g.yas pas utpal dmar po ni/ /'dab brgyad thugs kar kha 'byed pa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas pas te/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ /'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ /rā ga ra tī/ sems can gyi khams na gdon gyis nyen pa thams cad la bsrungs ba mdzad/ grub pa'i gos dkar mo/

nub byang gi re mig tu padma rtsegs pa'i gdan la/ byang shar gyi oṃ āḥtāṃ hūṃ dang*/ utpal ljang khur/ sgrol ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar/ /dang po sna tshogs rdor dril 'dzin/ /'khor lo utpal rdo rjes mtshan/ /rin chen ral gri g.yas g.yon na'o/ /don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /badzra ra tī/ sems can thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad/ grub pa'i sgrol ma/ byang shar gyi re mig tu/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūṃ/ me long dmar por/ dkar mo gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /rtsa phyag me long dmar po 'dzin/ /lhag ma sangs rgyas spyan ma bzhin/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ rū pa badzra/ gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs/ ye shes don dam pa'i gzugs kyi bde ba mchod/ grub pa'i gzugs rdo rje ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla ba la 'khod/ lho nub kyi oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang pi waṃ du/ ser mo sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum ste/ /rtsa phyag pi waṃ sngon po sgreng*/ /lhag ma mā ma ki dang mtshungs/ /mi bskyod rgyal pos dbu la brgyan/ /shapta badzra/ sgra'i skye mched sbyangs/ ye shes don dam pa'i sgra'i bde bas mchod/ grub pa'i sgra rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu rin po che'i gdan la 'khod/ nub byang gi oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ dang*/ dri bzang gis gang ba'i dung phor du/ dmar mo dri yi rdo rje ma/ /rtsa phyag dri bzang dung chos 'dzin/ /lhag ma gos dkar mo dang mtshungs/ /'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ /gan dhe badzra/ dri'i skyed mched sbyangs/ dri'i bde bas mchod/ nub byang du padma dmar po'i gdan la 'khod/ byang shar gyi oṃ āḥhoḥhūṃ dang*/ ro mchog gi snod du/ ljang khu ro yi rdo rje ma/ /rtsa phyag ro mchog gis gang snod/ khyad par gzhan rnams sgrol ma bzhin// rgyal ba rnga sgra'i cod pan can/ /rā sa badzra/ ro yi skye mched sbyangs/

ro'i bde bas grub pa'i ro rdo rje/ byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng gi oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ dang rdo rjer/ reg ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar/ /dang po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /'khor lo padma g.yas pas te/ /dril bu nor bu g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rgyal po'i cod pan can/ /spar sha badzra/ reg bya'i skye mched sbyangs/ reg bya'i bde bas/ grub pa'i reg bya rdo rje ma/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi pad mar 'khod pa'i reg bya rdo rje ma la thim par gyur/ lha mo dgu po thams cad ni/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ /nu 'bur lhag par rgyas pa bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ rig pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'o// rim pa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shar gyi g.yas kyi oṃ āḥmaiṃ hūṃ dang*/ klu shing gi yal ga 'khor los mtshan pa'i me tog dang bcas par/ byams pa rnam snang dang mtshungs pa las/ rnam snang gi cod pan can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na klu shing gi yal ga 'khor los mtshan pa'i me tog dang bcas pa'o/ /mai tri/ rtsa rgyus dang nyon mongs pa can gyi yid sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtsa dang zag zad kyi mngon shes la bkod/ grub pa'i byams pa/ lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yas su pad zla'i gdan la/ shar gyi g.yon gyi oṃ āḥ

hūṃ dang 'khor lo/ sa'i snying po rnam snang dang mtshungs pa/ kṣi ti garbha/ mig dbang rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i mig dang mig gi mngon shes la bkod/ lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yon du zla ba la/ lho'i g.yas kyi oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ dang rin po cher/ phyag na rdo rje rin chen 'byung ldan/ rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ badzra pā ṇi/ rna ba'i dbang po rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rna ba dang rna ba'i mngon shes la/ grub pa'i phyag na rdo rje/ lho'i g.yas su rin po che'i gdan la lho'i g.yon gyi/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ dang rin po cher/ nam mkha'i snying po rin chen 'byung ldan/ rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ kha garbha/ sna'i dbang po rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i sna dang*/ sna'i mngon shes la bkod/ grub pa'i nam mkha'i snying po/ lho'i g.yon du zla ba la/ nub kyi g.yas kyi oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ dang padmar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med/ /'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ /lo ke shwa ra/ lce'i dbang po rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lce dang lce'i mngon shes la bkod/ grub pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug /nub kyi g.yas su padma dmar po'i la/ nub kyi g.yon gyi oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang padmar/ 'jam dpal 'od dpag med/ 'og dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ mañdzu shrī/ yid dbang dang yid kyi rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i yid dang pha rol sems shes la bkod/ grub pa'i 'jam dpal/ nub kyi g.yon du padma dmar po'i gdan la byang gi g.yas kyi/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ dang ral grir/ sgrib pa rnam par sel ba/ don yod grub pa/ don grub gyi cod pan can/ sarba ni wa ra ṇa bi skaṃ bhi ni/ lus dbang rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lus dang rdzu 'phrul kyi mngon shes la/ grub pa'i sgrib pa rnam sel/ byang gi g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje la/ byang gi g.yon gyi/ oṃ āḥsaṃ hūṃ dang ral grir/

kun tu bzang po don yod grub pa/ don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ sa manta bha dra/ tshigs rnams dang kun gzhi rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje stobs dang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la bkod/ grub pa'i kun tu bzang po/ byang gi g.yon du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ de ltar lha mo rnams dang sems dpa' brgyad ni sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i lha tshogs de thams cad kyang 'dzum zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' bas rol pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgo'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang dbyug par/ gshin rje gshed nag nag dkar dmar/ dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje g.yas/ /thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i/ /zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi cod pan can/ /ya mān ta kṛta/ dbang po la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad bcom/ grub pa'i gshin rje gshed/ shar sgor pad nyi'i gdan/ lho sgo'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang*/ rdo rje mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar por/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po ni// dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri g.yas/ /g.yon ni gshin rje gshed dang mtshungs/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i cod pan can/ /pradzñānta kṛta/ gshin rje dang ma mo la sogs pa'i bgegs/ grub pa'i shes rab mthar byed/ lho sgor pad nyi'i gdan la/ nub sgo'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang padmar/ rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar/ /padma ral gri gtun shing g.yas/ /dril bu snyems pas dkur brten dang*/ /dgra sta zhags pa g.yon na'o/ /snang mtha' yas kyi cod pan can/ /padmānta kṛta/ klu dang sa bdag gi bgegs/ grub pa'i padma mthar byed/ nub sgor pad nyi'i gdan la/ byang sgo'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang sna tshogs rdo rjer/ bgegs mthar byed pa sngo sangs ni/ /sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa/

/rgya gram 'khor lo gtun shing g.yas/ /g.yon pa gshin rje gshed dang mtshungs/ rgyal ba rnga sgra'i cod pan can/ /bighnānta kṛta/ gnod sbyin dang log 'dren la sogs pa'i bgegs/ grub pa'i bgegs mthar byed/ byang sgor pad nyi la/ shar lho'i grwa'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang ral grir/ mi g.yo nag po nag dkar dmar/ /ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ g.yon pa thugs kar sdig 'dzub dang*/ /dgra sta zhags pa rim pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas snang mdzad cod pan can// a tsa la/ yams nad gtong ba dang me lha'i gdon rnams bcom grub pa'i mi g.yo ba/ shar lho'i grwar pad nyi la/ lho nub kyi grwa'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang rdo rjer/ 'dod rgyal sngon po sngo dkar dmar/ /rtsa phyag hūṃ mdzad phyag rgya 'ching*/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas pas te/ /zhags pa lcags kyu g.yon na'o/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi cod pan can/ /ṭakki rā dza/ srin po'i gdon sogs nye bar 'tsho ba rnams bcom/ grub pa'i 'dod rgyal/ bden bral gyi grwar pad nyi'i gdan la/ nub byang gi grwa'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang*/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con sngon por/ dbyug sngon sngon po sngo dkar dmar/ /be con ral gri 'khor lo g.yas/ /sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i zhags pa ni/ /thugs kar gtod cing padma dang*/ /dgra sta g.yon la rim pas so/ /rdo rje chos kyi cod pan can/ /nī la daṇḍa/ yams nad dang rlung lha'i gdon rnams bcom/ grub pa'i dbyug sngon can/ nub byang gi grwar pad nyi la/ byang shar gyi grwa'i/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang*/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag por/ stobs chen nag po nag dkar dmar/ /dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ / sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i zhags pa ni/ /thugs kar gtod cing rtse gsum dang*// dgra sta g.yon gsum rim pas so/ /don yod grub pa'i cod pan can/ /ma hā ba la/ dbang ldan mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang bcas pa bcom/ grub pa'i stobs po che/

byang shar gyi grwar pad nyi'i gdan la/ steng gi ya phubs kyi nang gi /oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang rdo rje/ gtsug tor 'khor los gyur ba sngo/ /zhal gsum sngo dkar dmar ba ste/ /rtsa phyag gtsug tor phyag rgya bcings/ spyi bor 'jog cing lhag ma yi/ /g.yas pas rdo rje padma ste/ /g.yon pa sdig mdzub ral gri'o/ mi bskyod rgyal bo'i cod pan can/ /uṣṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ tshang pa lha'i gdon dang bcas pa bcom grub pa'i gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ gzhal yas khang gi ya phubs kyi nang du pad nyi la/ 'og gi sa gzhi'i nang gi thig le/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ dang rdo rjer gyur pa las/ gnod mdzes nag po nag dkar dmar/ /rdo rje 'khor lo nor bu g.yas/ /thugs kar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang*/ /padma ral gri g.yon pas so/ /mi bskyod mgon po'i cod pan can/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ sum bha rā dza/ thugs ka nas phyir phyung nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par spros/ kā la ku ṭa la sogs pa brtan g.yo'i dug thams cad dang*/ gdon gyi bdag po thams cad bcom/ /sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la/ gdod nas grub pa'i gnod mdzes rgyal po ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du thim/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi 'og rdo rje'i sa bzhi'i nang du pad nyi la 'khod par gyur/ khro bo bcu po thams cad kyang sbom zhing thung la mi sdug pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ sbrul chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa ni/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan cing*/ padma dkar pos mgul rgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing*/

stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ska rags byas shing*/ padma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ stobs chen pha rol gnon pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar pa'i dbus na/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las la brtson pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang po hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa ni/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang phal cher 'dra ba las der brtags pa yin te/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis kyang sbrel ba ste/ 'dod rgyal nyid kyi phyag rgya yin no/ /gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya ni/ thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba las mthe chung gnyis khab ltar gshibs/ srin lag gnyis mthe bong gis mnan/ gung mo gnyis brkyang ste rtse sprad/ mdzub mo gnyis de la btsugs te/ g.yas g.yon du rwa'i tshul gyis byas pa'o/ /gsang 'dus 'phags bskor gyi skabs 'dir/ khro bo bcu la rol pa'i khro bo mi bzhed de/ thams cad cher khros pa'o/ / yum gyi padma'i nang gi gzhal yas khang*/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par spros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes kyi snang ba'i gzhal med khang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la/ gdod nas grub pa'i gzhal yas khang ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du thim/ de nyid dkyil 'khor chen po'i gzhal yas khang la thim par gyur/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor chen po dngas shing sgrib pa med pa/ zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin la mnyam par 'jog ste/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ / de nas phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ steng gi sna rtse 'am/ rdo rje'i lte bar thig le sogs la sems 'dzin pa ste/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ bskyed rim gyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/

tha mal pa gang la'ang ma chags shing*/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang mi phyed pa'i yid bzlas so/ /tshig tu brjod pa'i bzlas pa ni/ dam tshig gi bzlas pa sprau bsdu'i dmigs pa gtso bor gsal gdab/ bzlas bya'i sngags/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ni de kho na nyid kyi snying po'o/ / oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdzi na dz-ika oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥratna dhṛka swā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥ka āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradzñā dhṛka hā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra tī laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra tī maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra tī paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra ra tī taṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrū pa badzrā dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥshapta badzra hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ gandha badzra baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥr sa badzrā hoḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥsparsha badzrā khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmai tri meṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkṣi ti garbha hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra pā ṇi oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkha garbha oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmañdzu shrī hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsarba ni wa ra ṇa bi skaṃ bi ni oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥs manta bha dra saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mānta krita hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradzñānta krita hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpadmānta krita hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbighnānta krita hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥṭakki rā dzā hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇḍa hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmahā ba la hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.uṣṇī ṣa tsakra warti hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsumbha rā dza hūṃ hūṃ/ yum bzhi dang khro bo dgu'i 'phreng sngags ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid du gsal bar gsungs pa'o// gtso bo don dam la bzhugs pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos/ sems dpa' gsum ka 'od gsal du zhugs par gyur/ de nas glus bskul ba ni/ spyan mas/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ / dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/

/mgon po gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol/ / mā ma kīs/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan ston pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol/ / gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung te kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dges par mdzod/ / sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dges par mdzod/ / ces bskul pas/ gtso bo sems dpa' gsum yongs su rdzogs pa sngon bzhin du grub par gyur/ de nas bstod cing mchod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ / gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ / rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī āḥhūṃ/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ nghū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi te/ shapta/ rū pa/ shapta/ gandha/ ra sa/ sparsha/ ngharma dha tu zhes pa rnams sbyar ro/ / lha rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te bdud rtsi gsol bar gyur/ rdo rje 'chang chen phyag na rdo rje ind+ra bhu ti dang*/ /klu yi rnal 'byor ma dang bi su kalpa sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub yab sras bzhi dang zla grags slob pa'i rdo rje dang*/ /nag po sa 'dres de bā ka ra 'gos lo khug pa dang*/ / mngar seng rgyal ye shes seng ge nyi seng nyi ma lcam/ /rngog ston 'phags lha thang spe ba dang gser sdengs gzhon nu 'ong*/ chos sku 'od zer 'phags 'od bu ston rin chen rnam rgyal dang*/ /dpal mchog don grub tsand+ra shrī 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal ba/ /mkhyen rab mchog grub dkon mchog dpal bzang bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang*/ /dpal ldan chos bzang la sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lugs 'di la spyir brgyud pa bdun ldan gyi bka' srol tshang bas/ brgyud pa de dag gang nas drangs kyang 'dra'o/ /yang na/ bu ston khyung po lhas pa dang/ shar ngor paṇa chen chos rje rab gsal zla ba mgon po dang*/ grol mchog zhabs dang byams pa'i mtshan can rnams la mchod par 'bul/

zhes so/ /yang na/ bu ston bla ma dam pa dang*/ theg chen pa dang bsod nams bzang po rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ byang dbang shākya kun dga' ye shes dbang po rnams la 'bul/ zhes bya zhing*/ phyi ma 'di la 'gos lo tsā ba nas/ dbus pa dge ser sogs dang*/ sa skya gong ma lnga char la ded kyang chog pa yod do/ /de nas 'phreng sngags kyi mthar/ re re bzhin 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ bdud rtsi myang rjes chags kyi mchod pa sngon bzhin yid kyis dran pa tsam bya/ de nas nyer bsdu ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ 'khor gyi lha rnams spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ yab yub snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer spros te/ sems can thams cad la dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib sbyangs te hūṃ yig gi rnam pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya chen por gyur te/ de thams cad rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas/ rang nyid la thim par gyur zhes brjod la dbyings der cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de dag ni las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ / slar yang bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ chos thams cad rdo rje gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du lhag par mos pas thun mtshams kyi spyod pa la 'jug ste/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang ba thob gyur cig /'gro bas kyang ni de thob shog /byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gang yin pa/ /byang chub rdo rje gang gsungs pa'i/ /spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog / ces so/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ mchod gtor 'dus byas la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shungnghaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar pa'i nang du a las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ā ring pos mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su hūṃ las mi'i sha dang*/ dri chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar du oṃ las so ldan gyi sha dang dri chu oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor swā las mgyogs 'gro'i sha dang rakta swā yis mtshan pa/ nub tu a las khyu mchog gi sha dang*/ byang sems as mtshan pa/ byang du haṃ las shwa na'i sha dang*/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma hā yis mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyi thun mong gi steng du oṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang la/ zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros rlung g.yos me spar rdzas rnams skol ba'i nang du/ rdo rje zla ba dang bcas pa lhung nas dkrugs pas/ thams cad zhu nas ro mnyam du gyur pa/ dri ma sbyangs te dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ padma a dang bcas pa zhu bas nyi ma ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs shing*/ 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug ste thim pas/ spar zhing spel ba las/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /mchod pa'ang dngos su bshams yod na byin gyis rlabs dgos la/ dngos bsham med na mi dgos so/ / shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du bhruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje sems dpa' zhai sdang rdo rje'i rnam pa can la sogs pa/

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sprul/ mdun gyi gzhal med khang gi nang so so'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/ yang rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum dang*/ skye gnas bzhi dang rigs drug srid pa bar ma dang bcas pas bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du phyin pa tsam gyis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs su gyur nas/ lha tshogs snga ma dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ rang gi thugs ka nas gnod mdzes rgyal po spros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pū dza sogs kyis mchod/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rtse mor oṃ dang nor bus mtshan pa de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ gtor ma dbul ba'i sngags ni/ shanta de ba na re/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥsuṃ bha rā dza pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ zhes pa'i bar gyi 'bul bar 'dod/ de ltar byas kyang rung la lag len nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i gtor chog bzhin mdzad de/ oṃ āḥhūṃ oṃ swā āḥhā laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ maiaiṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ oṃ oṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ adya nudpanna twata/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/ rgyas pa byed na lha re re bzhin snying po'i mthar

a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod sngar bzhin phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / zhes sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sgos su mi byed na/ 'dir 'phrin las bcol ba man chad bya/ 'di 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa thams cad mnyam nyid du 'bul ba'i lugs yin pas/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog logs su med kyang chog pa'i dbang du byas nas/ shan ta de bas mchod bstod kyi rjes su/ chos bshad mdzad do/ /'on kyang lag len dam tshig rdo rje dang mthun par 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma logs su byed de/ de ltar de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa song nas/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog byas te/ 'phrin las gzhol pa phyogs cig tu bya zhing*/ sgos kyi bsrung ma nag po chen po sogs la 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma'i bar 'dir bya'o/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ / zhes mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ i dāṃ sthā na a dī naṃ sarba kṣe tra pā la sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa/ unmā da/ a pa smā ra/ sarba dāe ba/ sarba nā gsarba pā tha/ sarba ḍā ki n+ya sarba satwa/ sarba bhū ta/ a ta ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ ma ma sarba sa pa ri wā rā na/ sarba satwa nāñtsa/ sarba pā paṃ/ bya ti/ bigha na/ shintaṃ ku ru/ ngha na ngha n+ya/ a yu a ro kṣa/ a ti puṣtiṃ ku ru/ sarba bha ya rakṣa ku ru swāhā/ thams cad grub par mdzod cig /dge ba'i sems su mdzod cig

/ ces lan bdun la sogs pas gtor ma phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ pādyaṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpeḥhūṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rnam gsum dbyer med dngos/ /gdod nas rnam par dag pa yi/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /de dag rnams la'ang bstod par bgyi/ /oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang*/ /'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang*/ / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ /dri za lha min nam mkha' lding*/ /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za dang/ /smyo byed dang ni brjed byed dang*/ / gnon po la sogs pa rnams la/ /gtor ma 'bul gyis bsnams nas kyang*/ / bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi byin brlabs kyis/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gi bdud rtsi yi/ /bza' ba la ni longs spyod nas/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ thun mong du 'phrin las gzhol ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lha ni thams cad dang*/ /zhing skyong la sogs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /srid pa gsum na gang gnas pa/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa kun/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas te oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ye shes pa rnams rang la thim/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'dir gtor chog la/ phyis kyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis 'phreng ba ltar sbyar ba yang shin tu legs mod kyi/ 'dir 'gos lugs dang*/ rngog lugs kyi bla ma snga ma rnams mdzad pa'i lag len 'di/ don tshang phyin khyer bde bar snang pas bkod pa yin no/ /mar lugs kyi gtor chog kyang phal cher 'di dang 'dra'o/

/'dir smras pa/ 'di la sgrub thabs legs po mang yang*/ /phal cher tshig tshogs shin tu che bas/ /sgom don nyams su len pa lta zhog /tshig tsam skyor ba'ang dkar bar mthong la/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor re thag chad pas/ /ma smin skye bo tshogs pa'i dbus su/ /sgrub mchod ming btags lag len 'chol bas/ /dkor rdzas tsam zhig don du gnyer ba'am/ 'ga' zhig tshig gi bshad pa na yams/ /rtog ges bslad pa'i cal col mang pos/ mkhas grags tsam zhig don du gnyer te/ /bsgrub dkyil zab mo 'bad pas bzung ba'i//'bras bu de tsam cig la re'o/ /ha cang rgyas la skyon de mthong nas/ /tshig nyung 'dzin sla lag len bde 'di/ /nyams len 'dod pa 'ga' zhig srid na/ /de la phan nam snyam nas bkod do/ / tshig tshogs chen po ngoms par mi 'dod/ /dgos don zab mo gnad la sbyor na/ /'di tsam gyis kyang don mchog ston 'gyur/ /zhes bya'o/ /'di bris pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba srid med gang bsags des/ /srid pa gsum gnas sems can rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang chen thob par shog /ces pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su smras pa'o// //'dis kyang bstan 'gro la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal gsang 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal bzhugs/ -PAGE 32--PAGE 33--PAGE 1- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
